findings.title: Virtual environment directories indexed in repository audits

evidence.observation: Virtual environment paths in platform-runtime and core/infrastructure/vm-processing are being scanned as repository documentation and configurations
Vendor package YAML configurations from torchgen, rapidocr, and markdown_it are included in config file audit list

proposed_action.description: Add .venv directories across all subprojects to .gitignore and exclude virtual environments from filesystem audit scripts

findings.expected_benefit: Eliminates metric noise across 1,800+ vendor doc files and prevents vendor dependencies from polluting repository audit statistics

findings.title: Zero production Python source files detected despite 76 test suites

evidence.observation: Audit reports 0 python_files while detecting 76 active test files across the repository

proposed_action.description: Update repository audit file pattern matcher to correctly discover and index non-test Python implementation source modules

findings.expected_benefit: Restores visibility into Python codebase size, test-to-code coverage ratios, and source file health

findings.title: High average model router latency across recent requests

evidence.observation: Model router average execution duration is 6552ms across recent requests with no models currently kept hot in memory

proposed_action.description: Review model keep-alive policies and pre-warm frequent models such as gemma3:4b to avoid cold-start load delays

findings.expected_benefit: Reduces task turnaround latency for interactive routes like classify-capture and xo-response
